notes:
ACCESS: next.co.uk is Akamai-protected (errors.edgesuite.net, Akamai Bot Manager bm_s/bm_sz cookies). Direct fetch, a 10-profile curl_cffi sweep (chrome99-131, edge101, firefox133, safari15.5-18 incl. mobile), r.jina.ai (itself Cloudflare-challenged), and WebFetch all 403'd on every /shop/... and /homeware path (root '/' alone rendered fine, confirming path-specific bot rules, not a network-egress issue). translate.goog (www-next-co-uk.translate.goog) was the working route and returned genuine server-rendered origin HTML including an embedded search-state JSON with an exact 'search':{'totalResults':N} field per category page, cross-validated against a separate embedded left-nav facet blob ('link:<slug>':{'u','n','c'}) that independently listed sibling sub-categories with matching counts (e.g. Mirrors=548 in both the decorative-accessories facet list and its own page total; bathroom facet list gave all bathroom sub-nodes with counts in one shot). Re-fetched the three largest categories (Ceiling Lights 2090, Wall Art 2014, Desk & Table Lamps 1906) a second time; all stable, no drift. All qty values below are this 'search.totalResults' field, i.e. the site's own live listing total, not a tile count. Canonical https://www.next.co.uk/... URLs are recorded in every 'link' (translate.goog only used to fetch).

STRUCTURE: Next's homeware nav has NO 'Lighting by Room' or 'Mirrors by Room' branch -- lighting and the main Mirrors node are organised purely by fixture/product type. The only room-based branch that overlaps the type tree is the separate Bathroom department (/shop/home/bathroom), which has its own Mirrors (47), Wall Art (1), Ornaments (49) and Trays (4) sub-categories distinct in population from the main Home Accessories equivalents (Mirrors 548, Wall Art 2014) -- emitted as their own 'Bathroom' grouping per Rule 0.6, overlap documented here rather than dropped.

DEDUPE: 'Mirrors' and 'Photo Frames' each exist at two breadcrumb depths with IDENTICAL totals (home-accessories/mirrors = home-accessories/decorative-accessories/mirrors = 548; home-accessories/photo-frames = home-accessories/decorative-accessories/photo-frames = 556) -- same listing under two URLs at the same taxonomy level, so each kept ONCE under the shorter canonical Home Accessories URL, not duplicated under Decorative Accessories. /shop/home/kitchen-dining/tableware (2549) is a mixed roll-up superset of Kitchen's own cutlery+cups-mugs+dinnerware+glasses+serveware+table-linen children -- dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop them, don't pad'; the individual Kitchen children are used instead.

EXCLUDED (checked, not just skipped on name): Home Fragrance (whole node: diffusers, room-spray, pot-pourri, wax-melts-and-burners); artificial-flowers, garland, wreath, plant department flowers/plants (faux/live plant exclusion); Decorations (132, product-title-checked: pumpkins, Halloween/Christmas ornaments -- Holiday & Gift); Lighting Accessories (260, title-checked: cable kits, spare parts -- wiring/mounting hardware) and Light Bulbs (35) and Light Pulls (2) under Lighting; jewellery-storage, doorstops; all bedding/curtains-blinds/cushions-throws/rugs (textiles) except Curtain Poles (194, kept -- decorative curtain rods/finials, matches the Rule-0 'decorative metal: curtain rods' inclusion, not a textile); Cutlery (51) and Kitchen Storage & Organisation, Table Linen, Utensils & Food Prep under Kitchen; Drinks Bottles (372, title-checked: Stanley/Owala insulated steel hydration bottles and tumblers -- functional sports drinkware, not tableware glassware, so excluded despite the word 'bottles'); all Furniture, Garden/Outdoor furniture, Bedroom/Living-Room/Dining-Room furniture, Home Electricals and Kitchen Electricals (appliances), Nursery, Children's Room, Storage & Laundry, and the rest of Bathroom (textiles, furniture, cabinets, plumbing-adjacent fixtures, toiletries hardware) per Rule 0.4.

CANDLES: main Candles node (765) is majority scented (fragranced:yes facet count 599 of 765, fragranced:no 107) -- proven-inflated pattern per Rule 1's candle precedent, so the whole-node qty was NOT used. Instead emitted 'Candles (Unscented)' using the site's own fragranced=no facet listing (its own totalResults=107), matching the precedent used for The One UAE / West Elm / At Home / Perigold in this project. Candle Holders (359, not a fragrance product) kept as-is.

ORNAMENTS: title-checked both Home Accessories Ornaments (678) and Bathroom Ornaments (49) -- majority general decorative figurines/novelty objects (not majority holiday-specific), kept.
